newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline eases back, reaction to recent crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline eases back, reaction to recent crude.

text.p: NWE gasoline was $1 or so weaker on Friday as the impact of crude's recent fall's started to be felt.
Dealers said gasoline had a chance of staying firm on Friday if screen crude could have reversed some of the latest losses.

Eurograde barges were hovering around $187 fob ARA with cargoes assessed at $183 fob. The NWE is set to weaken relative to the Mediterranean where most of Nigeria's draw of 24 cargoes from now until late September are expected to be sourced from.
